questions.reason: Only equal elements can commute. First, a commutes with a², so a² = a. Next, a(aba) = aba = (aba)a, so aba = a. Finally (abc)(ac) = ab(cac) = abc and (ac)(abc) = (aca)bc = abc. Thus abc and ac commute and are equal.
